summary: TOP Financial Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment (Supplement No. 1) to its previously disclosed Securities Purchase Agreement with non-U.S. investors for the issuance of 214,431,222 units at $0.37308 per unit. The supplement adjusts share and warrant counts for any future stock split and extends the final closing deadline to 60 days from May 5, 2026. This is a routine adjustment to an existing equity offering, not a special situation event. The filing does not involve a change of control, restructuring, or strategic transformation. What to watch: completion of the remaining closings within the new deadline.
